headline: My New Home Build is Over Budget – What Went Wrong?
articleBody: It's a tough pill to swallow when your new home construction project starts creeping over budget. You're not alone, and often, it boils down to a few common culprits. One major factor is inadequate planning or a lack of detailed scope upfront. If your initial estimates aren't comprehensive, unforeseen costs will inevitably pop up. Another big one is frequent change orders; every modification after construction starts adds to both time and cost. Sometimes, homeowners are also unaware of the actual costs involved with certain materials or finishes they desire. Unexpected site conditions, like difficult soil or hidden utility lines, can also lead to costly delays and extra work. And, let's be honest, trying to DIY too much or working with unvetted subcontractors can introduce inefficiencies and errors that hit your wallet hard. To keep your new build on track, it's crucial to work with a general contractor who provides clear, transparent pricing and manages the project with a tight rein. At Affordable Home Remodeling, we emphasize clear scopes, realistic timelines, and value engineering, drawing on our 40+ years of combined experience to mitigate these budget busts. Early, thorough planning with an expert is truly your best defense.
